A Thoughtful Path Forward

You’re holding onto hope that life can feel calmer, lighter, and more grounded than it is right now.

In my practice, I help you transform that hope into lasting relief and sustainable well-being.

Whether you’re an adult seeking personal growth, looking to process trauma safely, or trying to manage intense professional burnout, therapy provides a compassionate and confidential space to unpack what feels overwhelming.

What you are experiencing is real, valid, and worthy of care. In my Santa Monica office and across California via telehealth, I help high-achieving individuals reconnect with themselves, release chronic tension, and build a resilient foundation for the future.

Learn more about Dr. Reynolds

Clinical Modalities

Many of my clients appear capable and functional on the outside while quietly carrying anxiety, tension, or chronic emotional fatigue. Here are three primary areas of clinical focus:

Trauma & EMDR

Paced, Body-Grounded Processing

Carefully paced work for single-incident trauma, childhood emotional wounds, or relationship distress. Using EMDR and body-oriented therapies, I help you feel more secure in the present.

Anxiety & Panic

Break Free from Overthinking

Support for constant worry, internal tension, sleeplessness, and the exhausting sensation of always bracing for something to go wrong. I combine CBT and nervous system regulation to help you regain clarity and ease.

Burnout & Pressure

For High-Achievers & Creatives

Support for when perfectionism, intense expectations, and years of overextending have left you feeling empty. We work on building sustainable limits and finding meaning that exists beyond your output.

You can be capable, accomplished, and still need support.

There is no need to have everything figured out before you begin.

MEET YOUR THERAPIST

Dr. Maya Reynolds, PsyD

Licensed Clinical Psychologist · California License PSY30219

I’m a licensed clinical psychologist based in Santa Monica, California, offering therapy for adults who feel overwhelmed by anxiety, stress, or the lingering effects of past experiences.

My work focuses on anxiety, panic, trauma, and burnout. Clients often come to me feeling functional on the outside while quietly carrying persistent worry, tension, difficulty sleeping, or a low-level dread they cannot quite name.

I take a warm, collaborative, and grounded approach. I take time to understand your unique life story rather than offering generic advice, and together we identify the patterns that keep you feeling stuck.

Sessions integrate CBT, EMDR, mindfulness-based practices, and body-oriented techniques — designed to give you practical insights and regulation tools you can use in daily life.

Good therapy doesn’t just solve problems — it changes the relationship you have with yourself.

Clinical Specialties

Clinical specialties include…

Focused, evidence-based support for adults navigating anxiety, trauma, EMDR, and burnout with care and intention.

Trauma & PTSD

In therapy, I gently help you process traumatic memories, restore a sense of physical safety, and reclaim autonomy, peace, and confidence.

Anxiety & Panic

I address the roots of anxiety and help your nervous system move from high alert toward calm balance.

EMDR Therapy

EMDR is a researched method that can help rework how unresolved trauma is stored and support emotional relief.

Burnout & High Pressure

Tailored support for those whose identity has become inseparable from their productivity — helping you disentangle self-worth from output and restore a sense of vitality.

MY SANTA MONICA SPACE

A quiet, grounding space for healing.

My Santa Monica office is a private sanctuary intentionally designed to feel welcoming, calm, and restorative from the moment you arrive. With abundant natural light, comfortable furnishings, and an uncluttered environment, the space itself invites you to exhale, settle, and feel at ease.
